text:
sara: Quick sync 1 follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. Need to finalize owners + delivery dates for remediation items: quota guardrails, scheduler tuning experiments, headroom runbook, and automated alerts. Trying to close the loop this sprint.

miguel: I'll take quota guardrails - plan: define per-customer burst limits, emergency global throttle, and a short credit system for transient spikes. Proposal by Tue EOD.

kevin: Scheduler tuning is on me. I'll run a small sweep in staging (bin-packing weights, affinity, preemption scope). Expect results by Thu.

ashley: I'll write the emergency headroom runbook (detection thresholds, comms templates, mitigation steps like model pool fallback). Will coordinate with kevin for thresholds. Draft by Fri.

dmitri: Ops automation: I'll wire ops-bot to post daily snapshots and create Jira when spare_gpus < 15% for two checks. Prototype alert + ticket creation by next Mon.

jane: Product suggestion: include a soft-rollout block that prevents automatic model rollouts when spare_gpus < 25%. I'll capture requirements.

miguel: For guardrails: propose per-customer burst cap (percent of committed), a rolling 5-min credit bucket, and admin override for sales.

kevin: Tuning checklist: 1) raise memory weight for bin-packing, 2) prefer packing long-lived model pods on reserved nodes, 3) restrict group preemption to preemptible pools. Example pseudo-config I'll test in staging.

ashley: Runbook outline: detection -> threshold escalation -> mitigation steps -> post-incident validation. Example mitigation: "route traffic to quantized model pool for up to 5m and measure p99 latency." Need exact CLI cmds and playbook links.

kevin: Snippet I'm testing (pseudo-yaml):
```
clusterPolicy:
  binPacking:
    weightMemory: 1.6
    weightCPU: 1.0
  preemption:
    enabled: true
    scope: group
  desiredHeadroom: 0.20
```

sara: Note: Dedicated customers cannot be auto-migrated; add a dedicated vs hosted policy note.

dmitri: ops-bot alert proto:
```
alert: LowSpareGPUs
expr: spare_gpus_percent < 15
for: 10m
labels: { severity: "warning" }
```
If fired twice, create REM ticket and ping #oncall.

miguel: Timelines recap: quota guardrails - Tue (1956744000), scheduler tuning results - Thu (1956906800), headroom runbook - Fri (1957003200), ops-bot prototype - Mon (1957132800), fallback routing reqs - Tue (1956744000).

sara: I'll open Jira tickets now and set a recurring weekly checkpoint until all items are closed. @ops-bot can you schedule a Monday reminder?

ops-bot: reminder-created: "Headroom remediation weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. First: 1956706800. (reacts: :white_check_mark:)

kevin: One more: consider safety cap for new model rollouts when spare_gpus < 25% to avoid rollouts during low headroom.

jane: Product agrees. Disable auto-rollouts past the threshold; require manual approval for canary/gradual rollouts.

ashley: Adding to runbook: "auto-rollout disabled when spare_gpus < 25% - manual approval required."

miguel: Also add a 48h post-remediation spike test to validate fixes.

sara: Good call. Tie the 48h test to the remediation Jira ticket closure.

dmitri: I'll add a hook: when REM ticket closes, ops-bot schedules a spike test job and posts results in thread.

sara: Owners consolidated here: - quota guardrails: miguel (deliver Tue 1956744000) - scheduler tuning: kevin (results Thu 1956906800) - headroom runbook + rollout caps: ashley (draft Fri 1957003200) - ops-bot alerts + snapshot job: dmitri (prototype Mon 1957132800) - fallback routing requirements: jane (Tue 1956744000)

sara: If no objections I'll create the tickets and assign. Close this thread once tickets are created and initial proposals posted.

kevin: sounds good.

miguel: go for it.

ops-bot: jira-created: REM-7210 assigned-to: miguel, REM-7211 assigned-to: kevin, REM-7212 assigned-to: ashley (links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-7210).

sara: Thanks all. We'll review in the weekly ops check-in. :thumbsup:
